```{r}
library(datenanpassr)
library(tidyverse)
mapping_file <- system.file("extdata", "mapping.xlsx", package = "datenanpassr")
spss_file <- system.file("extdata", "fake_survey.sav", package = "datenanpassr")
mapping_s3 <- Mapping$new(spss_file, mapping_file)
# filter commands that are already implemented:
cbs <- mapping_s3$cmd$command_blocks
unique_cmd_bloks <- cbs[!duplicated(map_chr(cbs, "action"))]
type_list <-  tibble(
  action = map_chr(unique_cmd_bloks, "action"),
  unique_cmd_bloks %>% 
    map("args") %>% 
    map_dfr(~map(.x, typeof))
)
  
# %>% 
#   mutate(action = unique_cmd_bloks %>% map_chr("action"))
type_list
```
